derivation: The root is a FANOUT_EXPAND step whose region head is the entry of a loop wholly inside the object region: loop-head routes to loop-tail, which chooses CONTINUE back to loop-head or EXIT to the fan-out join. COMPOSITION admits a fan-out region head whose only incoming edge other than the fan-out's implicit edge is an admitted back edge wholly inside that object region. The root's matching effect carries one object. LIFE-018 freezes the set and creates the object obligation and occurrence atomically. COMPOSITION's loop rule gives every operation occurrence in the loop one LOOP segment, with fan-out segments in their outer-to-inner positions, and entry from outside allocates pass 1. The loop-head occurrence's enclosing path is therefore the object's FANOUT segment followed by the LOOP segment at pass 1. The completed expand occurrence records a null selected relationship, and the ROUTE detail names only the fan-out.
